title: Anwiinwii a Wɔtee Wɔ Dede no Atifi
intro: Wote nne bi a ɛresɔre afi ɔman a nhyɛso abɛyɛ ade a wɔyɛ daa wom mu. Tumi a wɔda no adi biara nni anwiinwii no ho mmuae; mmom no, adesrɛ tẽẽ du Allah nkyɛn, na mmuaeɛ no bɔ ɔsom no ankasa akoma mu. Hena na odii saa anwiinwii no, asɛmmisa bɛn na edii akyi bae, na nokware bɛn na wosii so dua?
clues: Nnipa a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no nhyɛso no bɛhaw me.
Mede saa anwiinwii no kyerɛɛ Allah tẽẽ wɔ m’ankasa anwiinwii mu.
Allah tee anwiinwii no na ɔde asɛnnennen bi buae wɔ m’ankasa me gyidie ho.
Mmuaeɛ no bisaa sɛdeɛ mɛtumi annye Allah a ɔyɛ Baako ne Ɔsorosoroni no nni.
Afei mebisaa deɛ enti a ɛsɛ sɛ Allah dom nkurɔfoɔ a wɔannye nni.
Mene Uzair, a woabo ne din wo Surah Az-Zukhruf mu se deɛ Allah tee n’anwiinwii.

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Allah tee anwiinwii no na ɔsii ɔsoro Baakoyɛ ne Awurade a Ɔkorɔn no so dua

outcome.answer: Allah tee anwiinwii no na ɔsii ɔsoro Baakoyɛ ne Awurade a Ɔkorɔn no so dua

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
